rationale: The assistant gave safe, low-cost steps (dial, ventilation, seal and defrost advice) and correctly pushed the tenant to report to the letting agent, with a ready-made message. It leaned toward low refrigerant on thin evidence, for example 'A freezer that's fine with a warm fridge is a classic sign of this', and stated the model is 'static' with a back-panel evaporator, which the customer's evidence did not support. It also did not push the full defrost as the main test after the customer said they would try the dial and drop test first, though it did cover defrost earlier and avoided naming any part to buy.
